chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from the one who informed him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I found in some of the books: Whoever sends blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, Allah will write for him a hundred good deeds; and whoever says 'May Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and the people of his house', Allah will write for him a thousand good deeds.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for sending blessings upon Prophet Muhammad and his family according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reports finding in heavenly scriptures that sending blessings upon Prophet Muhammad and his progeny yields a hundred good deeds, while reciting the specific supplication 'Sallallahu ala Muhammad wa ahli baytihi' yields a thousand good deeds. This distinction highlights the elevated status of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia theology, linking the general command of Salawaat in Surah Al-Ahzab with the specific intercessory and spiritual authority of the Prophet's household. The narration underscores the tangible spiritual rewards for adherents who maintain strong ties with the Prophet's family through dedicated supplication.
